evidenceBoundary: The built single-file Whiteboard app runs inside the sandboxed ExtensionHost with deterministic local Space, model-catalog, model-completion, and image-search services. Rendered tests verify persisted Space read-back, exact bridge request payloads, and selected image bytes. No live Core, provider, network image service, or account is used.
